name: tool-teacherbot-test-tooling
description: Source for the vendored client JS. marked 18.0.7 is served from system1-flask-chat/static/js/marked.umd.js (#25); this pin is what regenerates that file on upgrade. Tests do NOT consume this dependency — render_check.mjs evaluates the vendored bundle directly, so it exercises the bytes the browser runs and needs no install.

scripts.vendor:marked: npm ci && cp node_modules/marked/lib/marked.umd.js system1-flask-chat/static/js/marked.umd.js && cp node_modules/marked/LICENSE system1-flask-chat/static/js/marked.LICENSE.txt && sed -i.bak '/sourceMappingURL=marked.umd.js.map/d' system1-flask-chat/static/js/marked.umd.js && rm -f system1-flask-chat/static/js/marked.umd.js.bak
